name: sprint13_taker_imbalance_altcoins
hypothesis: Taker-buy imbalance predicts 15m drift in lower-liquidity top-20 USDT alts (ADA, AVAX, BNB, DOGE, LINK, LTC, SOL, XRP), where informed flow is less quickly arbitraged than BTC/ETH (sprint05's clean fail on the two most liquid, most efficient pairs).
power_argument: Same param family and cost model as sprint05 (dispersion ~33bp std, T2 round-trip floor ~26bp; min detectable edge at n=300,t=2 ~3.8bp, well below the cost floor). 8 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap 10/day = up to 7360 possible entries; sprint05 realized 920/symbol under identical thresholds on 2 symbols, so >=300 is near-certain.
